body:
**CL term:**
- [CL_0002423](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0002423) — DN2a thymocyte
- [CL_0002424](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0002424) — DN2b thymocyte

For both DN2a and DN2b:
[x] in taxon: Mus musculus
[ ] never in taxon
[ ] present in taxon

**Rationale**
DN2a and DN2b are defined based on c-Kit (CD117) expression levels (Kit-high vs Kit-low), following the classical DN1–DN4 (CD44/CD25) staging system. This staging system is validated only in mouse thymopoiesis.
Human thymocyte development does not utilize DN2a or DN2b nomenclature, and Kit-high/Kit-low DN2 subsets are not reproducibly defined in human thymus. The Cell Ontology comment for DN2a explicitly states: “Observed in mice… molecular markers characterizing double negative thymocytes are different across species.”
Therefore, these terms should receive an explicit “in taxon: Mus musculus” constraint. The absence of a taxon annotation (and the presence of human_subset tags) is currently misleading.

**References:**
PMID: 25060579 — Review of mouse DN1–DN4 staging; DN2a/DN2b defined via Kit-high/Kit-low only in mouse.
PMID: 20543111 — Experimental definition of DN2a (Kit-high) and DN2b (Kit-low) in adult mouse thymus.
PMID: 32079746 — Human thymus single-cell atlas; DN2a/DN2b subsets not observed or defined in human development.
title: [Taxon constraint] Add taxon constraints to DN2a (CL_0002423) and DN2b (CL_0002424)
